title: Transdermal delivery of near-infrared photothermal-responsive PDA@Ag through dissolvable carboxymethyl chitosan films coated on PEGDA microneedle arrays for potential antibacterial applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37273-37287
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04189A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ya Gao, Haoping Huo, Jianlin Li, Nengqing Wang, Haonan Gao, Yingbo Wang
We developed a PEGDA microneedle patch with a CMC film containing PDA@Ag NPs. It enhances skin permeability for rapid drug release, enabling antimicrobial and analgesic treatment of skin infections.
